name: Band Triceps Extension
description: Strengthens the back of the upper arm: one hand anchors the band at the opposite hip while the other arm straightens behind you.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: resistance band exercises
source.note: Standing version. The article also shows each exercise seated on a chair.

setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold one end of the band against your right hip with your left hand.
Hold the other end in your right hand just behind the hip, elbow pointing back.
cues: If you can't straighten all the way, go as far as you can.

prescription.note: Aim for 2 to 3 sessions a week with a rest day between. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check with your doctor or cardiac rehab team first.

keyframes.name: Elbow back
keyframes.cue: Right hand just behind your hip, elbow pointing behind you.

keyframes.name: Extend
keyframes.cue: Straighten your right arm and lift the hand behind you.
